rationale: The workflow already implements the relevant evidence-supported optimizations: fail-fast is already true (P-LIT-FAIL-FAST), and micromamba dependency caching is already enabled via cache-environment: true and cache-downloads: true (equivalent to P-LIT-DISTRIBUTED-CACHE / P-LIT-GHA-CACHE). The remaining candidate, P-LIT-HISTORY-TIMEOUT (adding a job timeout), is not safely supported: the measured evidence adds timeout-minutes: 5 to jobs running in ~23 seconds, while this workflow's successful CI runs take approximately 5-7.5 minutes, so a 5-minute limit would cause false timeouts on valid runs, violating the contraindication that valid slow runs must not exceed the proposed limit. No other evidence-supported optimization applies without weakening coverage or adding unrelated changes.
